one_liner: A multi-step approve→lock→execute→settle workflow with real retry and compensation — proven by a genuine mined failure receipt followed by confirmed compensation transactions.
what_it_does: This lamp runs a four-step saga — approve, lock, execute, settle — where each step must succeed before the next starts, and a mined on-chain failure triggers automatic compensation. Transient errors get bounded retries with backoff; confirmed failures unwind the completed steps in reverse order. Proven by 13 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet: a clean run through all four steps, plus a forced-failure run that mined a genuine status:0 receipt (0x91f7e021…) and was followed by two confirmed compensation transactions that restored the exact token balance.
